# Get Validator Owner [validator.getOwner]

Gets the validator config owner.

## Usage

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"829d95b6a69259cf5253d16d8485d4e40be731f4314e005a58a9e0d70eaa94b2","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const result = await client.validator.getOwner()

console.log('Result:', result)
// @log: Result: 0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEbb
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

## Recipes

### Gate Admin Tooling to the Config Owner

Check the owner before running restricted operations like [`validator.changeStatus`](/tempo/actions/validator.changeStatus): mutations from any other account revert.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"bc66c0f8f686fdb26349b525791a9d39574a1f596120f6b882dd4d9ebd773426","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const owner = await client.validator.getOwner() // [!code focus]

if (owner !== client.account.address) // [!code focus]
  throw new Error('connected account cannot manage the validator set')

const { receipt } = await client.validator.changeStatusSync({
  active: false,
  validator: '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEbb',
})
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"

```

:::

## Return Value

```ts
type ReturnType = Address
```

The validator config owner address.
